plans.note: Review Section 21 for cap amount, mutuality and consequential-damages exclusion; check the Section 1 definition of 'Excluded Claims' for the carve-out set and cross-check Section 20 indemnities are uncapped.

Section 20 is the primary location; confirm Vendor IP infringement, data breach and misconduct indemnities exist and that any Customer indemnity is narrow. Cross-reference Section 14 (IP) and Section 15 (Customer Data) for defence obligations.
No dedicated restrictive-covenants section; scan Customer Responsibilities (12), Scope (2) and General (30) for any competing-product or build-restriction language before concluding absent.
Check Agreement Structure and Scope (2) and Order Forms (4) for sole-source or 'all requirements' wording; likely absent but exclusivity often hides in scope or ordering clauses.
Directional check in Fees (7) and Order Forms (4): an MFN favouring us is acceptable, but flag any obligation on us to extend best terms or benchmark pricing to the Vendor.
Non-solicits typically sit in General (30) or near Confidentiality (16); if present, confirm mutuality, a 12-month cap and a general-advertising carve-out.

Section 9 governs termination rights; verify we have convenience termination on reasonable notice without penalty and that the Vendor lacks a mid-term convenience right. Check Section 10 for early-termination fees.
Section 8 should set the auto-renewal mechanic and non-renewal notice window (target 30 days, cap uplift); cross-check Section 7 for renewal price escalators.
Section 28 covers governing law, venue and any arbitration; confirm an approved law (NY, DE, CA, E&W) and courts rather than foreign-seated arbitration.
Section 24 addresses assignment and change of control; confirm our affiliate/successor assignment right and remove any Vendor termination trigger on our change of control.

Directional review of Section 14 (Deliverables ownership) and Section 15 (Customer Data); reject Vendor ownership of Deliverables or any licence-back/assignment of our data beyond service provision, and check Section 13 for Vendor Technology overreach.
Section 13 sets the access/licence scope; confirm Affiliates and contractors are permitted users and that the grant is not revocable at will or unilaterally suspendable.

Section 22 governs audits of our usage; require notice, business hours, once per 12 months, remote where possible and Vendor cost. Section 23 (Records) may contain overlapping record-retention obligations on us.

Directional check: service credits in Section 3 are acceptable, but flag liquidated damages, penalties or late-fee/interest amounts payable by us in Section 7 and any penalty carve-out from the Section 21 cap.

Section 19 should give a professional-services and conformance warranty of meaningful duration with repair/re-perform plus refund; cross-check Section 3 performance standards, Section 6 acceptance remedies and any disclaimer of implied warranties.
Section 18 exists; confirm coverage lines and limits (CGL, professional liability/E&O, cyber, workers' comp) plus certificates and notice of cancellation given the Vendor hosts our data (Section 17).
Look for minimum volume, take-or-pay or non-reducible commitments in Fees (7), Order Forms (4) and Term (8); if present, pair with a downward-flex or termination exit.

Section 11 covers transition assistance and data return; confirm a defined assistance period, machine-readable export format, pricing certainty and that deletion obligations in Sections 10/15 do not precede our retrieval.
